name: Projected No-Clashing Teaching Separation Class
definition: On coordinates $\{0,1,2,3\}$, the **Projected No-Clashing Teaching Separation Class** is $$\mathcal C_{\mathrm{pNC}}=\{0000,0001,0010,0011,0100,1101\},$$ where a string lists the labels in coordinate order.
